comments.author: Greev
comments.body_html: Yeah, some of the elite buffs are really really good too. Elite strength makes your equipped weapons weightless, immunity makes it so you’ve got a good chance of not getting any debuffs from consumables (including stims, which makes some really bad stims really good), elite searching allows you to search 2 containers at once (like rig + bag/pockets when looting a body), elite vitality makes bleeds stop on their own (after a certain period of time, effectively allowing you to ignore light bleeds), elite crafting allows you to craft 2 items at once in the same station, elite hideout management adds 2 extra slots to all of your hideout modules (3 water filter slots instead of 1, 2 extra fuel slots, 2 extra air filter slots, etc.), elite mag drills makes it so you always know exactly how many rounds are in each mag in your inventory and loading mags gets faster the more rounds you load (helps most with really large mags), elite surgery makes fixed limbs not lose any HP.
